name: Vasco da Gama Reaches India
summary: Vasco da Gama's fleet arrives at Calicut, India, completing the first European sea voyage to Asia. The route around the Cape of Good Hope bypasses the Ottoman-controlled eastern Mediterranean and undermines the Venetian and Mamluk monopoly on spice trade. Within decades, Portuguese control of Indian Ocean sea lanes transforms global commerce.

_quarry.structural_significance: Opens the age of direct European-Asian trade; destroys the Mamluk economic model; begins the displacement of Islamic commercial dominance in the Indian Ocean; one of the most consequential voyages in history.
